emily_pm: Quick sync — seller milepost pricing + 'escape' handoff for private offers. Need a one-pager + launch cadence by EOD Wed. Context: HW partners want an escape if usage < threshold in 90d; SIs want predictable credits during POCs. Can we agree on standard guardrails?
omar_partner: Agree we need a template. My proposal: 3-tier commit bands (pilot, growth, enterprise) with clear usage milestones and a single-step escape window at day 90. Escape triggers pro-rated credit return, not cash. Keeps partner ops sane.
jess_sales: +1 on credit return vs cash. Field needs a simple button: "initiate escape" and an ops doc. Also request: limit escape to one per 12 months per account to avoid churn gaming.
neil_gpm: Draft price bands idea:
```
Pilot: commit $10k -> 15% off list, 30d POC, escape if usage < 40% of commit in 90d
Growth: commit $100k -> 20% off list, 90d ramp milestones, escape if usage < 30% in 90d
Enterprise: commit $500k+ -> custom discounts, staggered renew window, escape handled case-by-case
```
This keeps math simple for sellers.
emily_pm: Nice. Two questions: 1) how do we compute "usage" (tokens billed vs committed $ or seats)? 2) who approves escapes — PS or partnerships?
omar_partner: For compute simplicity, measure against consumed spend (dollars invoiced toward committed SKU) rather than tokens. Approvals: auto-approve if usage < threshold AND account hasn't used marketplace credits previously; otherwise require partnership ops review.
jess_sales: For joint announcement timing: propose hold public announcement until we confirm HW partner escape clauses are in 1-pager. Partners want a synchronized press/field enablement. Can marketing squeeze a short FAQ?
neil_gpm: I'll own the FAQ draft. Also propose a short seller playbook: 1-line pitch, sample email template, and a troubleshooting checklist for escape requests.
emily_pm: Action items:
- neil_gpm: draft price bands + FAQ (ETA Tue COB)
- omar_partner: draft legal-friendly escape language for credit return (ETA Tue COB)
- jess_sales: list top 8 sellers to brief and collect feedback (ETA Wed AM)
- emily_pm: consolidate into one-pager and cadence for joint announce (ETA Wed EOD)

Also need engineering note: if we do automated escape checks, we need a daily job to compute usage ratios and flag accounts. deploybot: scheduled a ticket in infra backlog: #PR-4981 created for marketplace-escape-calculation job (link: https://go/redwood/PR-4981).

omar_partner: One more nuance — SI-led POCs sometimes use partner-managed billing which hides usage in our system. Recommend a clause that requires usage reporting or we mark those as ineligible for auto-escape and send to manual review.
jess_sales: Good call. We'll add that to seller FAQ. Also recommend a short internal play: if customer is below threshold but engaged, seller can escalate to a "grace" review to avoid losing momentum.
neil_gpm: Final note on renewals: auto-opt-in to a 'conversion window' for accounts that hit >=80% of commit in first 270d. Gives sellers a clean upsell motion.
emily_pm: Thanks all — I'll stitch together and share the one-pager in this thread once done. If anyone wants to pair on language, ping me. :thumbsup:
